title: Paired Multimodal Scaling Laws
abstract: arXiv:2609.36263v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing multimodal scaling laws fit multimodality terms empirically after testing and never vary how much data is multimodally paired at fixed data budgets. We investigate how, under the same total data per modality, changing the number of paired data affects loss curves in multimodal classification tasks. We train models in three different environments and run experiment sweeps varying data sizes and pairing budget. Pairing ratios have a dramatic impact on loss and this impact is directly tied to how much information synergy the task contains. Only paired data is able to reduce synergistic loss, while unpaired data can reduce redundant or unimodal information up until unimodal floors. Unlike traditional scaling laws where loss drops immediately in power law decay, synergy acquisition is gated, requiring a critical threshold of paired data before synergistic loss falls at all. translated_abstract: 现有的多模态缩放定律是在测试后凭经验拟合多模态项的，并且在固定数据预算下从不改变多模态配对数据的数量。我们研究了在每种模态总数据量相同的情况下，改变配对数据的数量会如何影响多模态分类任务中的损失曲线。我们在三种不同的环境中训练模型，并进行了改变数据规模和配对预算的实验扫描。配对比例对损失有显著影响，且这种影响与任务所包含的信息协同量直接相关。只有配对数据能够降低协同损失，而非配对数据只能降低冗余或单模态信息，直至达到单模态下限。与传统缩放定律中损失立即以幂律形式衰减下降不同，协同信息的获取是受门控的，需要配对数据达到某个临界阈值之后协同损失才会开始下降。我们由此引入了一族新的多模态缩放定律……
tldr: 该论文发现配对比例对多模态任务损失有决定性影响——只有配对数据能降低协同损失且需超过临界阈值才生效，并据此提出了一族全新的多模态缩放定律。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that pairing ratios dramatically affect multimodal loss—only paired data can reduce synergistic loss, gated by a critical threshold—and introduces a new family of multimodal scaling laws.
